symbols.name: reset_vector
symbols.summary: The first ARM vector branches to reset_entry at 0x20.

evidence.note: EA000006 decodes as ARM b 0x20.

symbols.name: reset_entry
symbols.summary: Privileged ARM startup; preserves incoming r0-r2 in banked FIQ registers before further initialization.

evidence.note: MSR CPSR_c,#0xd1; MOV r8,r0; MOV r9,r1; MOV r10,r2.

symbols.name: select_rom_or_sram_path
symbols.summary: Tests bit 0 at MMIO 0x00706034: clear reaches PC=0x20000, set continues ROM startup. Register semantics remain unresolved.

evidence.note: Literal load, dereference, TST #1, BNE 0xc0, MOV pc,#0x20000.
The addressed literal is 0x00706034.

symbols.name: enter_rom_dispatch
symbols.summary: Transfers to the ROM continuation at 0x8ed0 after privileged-mode and stack setup.

evidence.note: LDR r0,[pc,#0x1bc]; BX r0.
The target literal is 0x8ed0.

symbols.name: clear_registers_and_halt
symbols.summary: Clears r0-r12 and enters a self-loop at 0x230. This is the terminal sink, not the whole error/recovery policy.

evidence.note: Beginning of the register-clear sequence.

symbols.name: copy_aligned_words
symbols.summary: r0=destination, r1=source, r2=byte count; copies 32-byte blocks then words, preserving input registers. Not a general unaligned byte memcpy.

evidence.note: Saves registers and retains destination/source/count in r8/r9/r10.
Eight-word load/store followed by count -= 0x20.
Remainder loop transfers a full word and subtracts four.

symbols.name: zero_aligned_words
symbols.summary: r0=destination, r1=byte count; zeroes in 32-byte blocks then words. Call sites use word-aligned storage and lengths.

evidence.note: Saves registers, retains destination/count, and begins clearing the store registers.
Stores eight zero words and subtracts 0x20.

symbols.name: early_path_register_address
symbols.summary: Literal 0x00706034 used by the first ROM/SRAM selector. Not identified as a secure-boot-enable register.

evidence.note: Little-endian MMIO address, referenced at 0xac.

symbols.name: enter_download_manager
symbols.summary: Requests clock profile code 0x14, then tail-enters 0x362c with r0=2. Complete transport semantics are deferred.

evidence.note: Profile request, restored frame, r0=2, branch to 0x362c.

symbols.name: download_manager_candidate
symbols.summary: Common entry reached by download wrappers with r0=2; USB/controller and command-dispatch internals are not mapped in this pass.

evidence.note: The pbl_dload-associated wrapper calls 0x362c with argument 2.

symbols.name: authenticate_loaded_image
symbols.summary: Separate boot stage: consults cached auth policy, processes certificates and verifies the signed header/code. No live policy value is known.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 20, after loading and before shared-data construction.
BL 0xf840, certificate processing.
BL 0xf284, signed-image verification.

symbols.name: initialize_auth_context
symbols.summary: Sets C+0x1c to the auth context at 0x20660 and initializes hardware-derived policy and root-related fields.

evidence.note: Boot callback in word slot 6; also reused by recovery.

symbols.name: set_auth_image_regions
symbols.summary: Stores code/header/signature/certificate addresses and lengths at A+0x18..0x34. This setter does not authenticate.

evidence.note: Called by the loader after the payload read.
STM stores the eight range words through r2=A+0x18.

symbols.name: publish_auth_fields
symbols.summary: Copies cached authentication fields to S+0x28..0x4c and publishes a ROM blob pointer at S+0x50; some field meanings remain inferred.

evidence.note: Called by the shared-record builder.
Copies the pair A+0x10/+0x14 to S+0x38/+0x3c.

symbols.name: retry_mode_0x101_then_download
symbols.summary: Gated retry reinitializes part of runtime/auth state and replays slots 14..23 in mode 0x101; may hand off to the image before a once-only download fallback.

evidence.note: Recovery handoff loads entry/shared pointer and sets LR=0x6488 before BX.
Also exposed in the ROM service table.

symbols.name: is_load_range_allowed
symbols.summary: Tests a destination interval against registered load ranges. Full storage and security policy is not implied by this check.

evidence.note: Loader calls the range-check routine before the payload read.

symbols.name: boot_main
symbols.summary: Runs hardware/runtime preludes, walks 24 word slots with 12 non-null callbacks, checks loaded state, and tail-hands off with the shared record.

evidence.note: Word-indexed callback load, null skip, r0=context, indirect call.
Increment word-slot index, compare against 24, loop.
Dispatch table 0x10ce0 and context 0x202a8 literals.

symbols.name: normal_sbl_handoff
symbols.summary: r1=C.entry; r0=C.shared=0x20240. Restores the boot-main frame before BX r1; differs from the recovery call-like handoff.

evidence.note: Pre-indexed writeback advances r4 to C+0x14; the second load therefore reads C+0x28.

symbols.name: boot_hardware_prelude
symbols.summary: Early hardware gating/MMIO setup before runtime-memory initialization; includes a conditional terminal halt. Register meanings are incomplete.

evidence.note: First direct call in boot_main.

symbols.name: boot_error_recovery
symbols.summary: Nonreturning error handling may attempt recovery and an SBL handoff; only its terminal fallthrough reaches the register-clear/halt sink.

evidence.note: Boot main reports a callback failure here, including the word-slot index.
Conditional BL to recovery at 0x63b8.
Terminal fallthrough calls 0x1fc, not the only possible outcome.

symbols.name: select_media_backend
symbols.summary: Dispatches C.path to SDCC-, SPI- or download-associated backends, establishes F=0x203bc, and checks the backend interface.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 14; recovery starts replay here.
Stores the media-context pointer at C+0x18.

symbols.name: read_image_via_media
symbols.summary: Wrapper dispatches an image-read descriptor through F+0x18. Media-origin units and controller operations remain later work.

evidence.note: Loader passes F and its stack descriptor to this wrapper.

symbols.name: read_header_via_media
symbols.summary: Wrapper dispatches through F+0x1c to read the retained header; the SDCC adapter requests 0x50 bytes.

evidence.note: Header-read call in the image loader.

symbols.name: initialize_sdcc_backend
symbols.summary: SDCC-associated backend selected for path codes 1-4, 14, 15 and 0x101, or the first attempt in mode 0x100. Driver internals are deferred.

evidence.note: Normal storage backend call from the path dispatcher.
First attempt of the storage-then-download mode.

symbols.name: initialize_spi_backend
symbols.summary: SPI-associated backend selected for path codes 5, 9 and 16; controller implementation is deferred.

evidence.note: Backend call after those path-code cases.

symbols.name: consume_boot_cookie
symbols.summary: Matches three-word cookies at 0x43e50, records selector 0-3 at C+0x2c and clears matched cookie words; transport meanings remain partly inferred.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 10, before boot-path selection.

symbols.name: enter_download_backend
symbols.summary: Download-associated path calls 0x362c with r0=2. If it returns, this wrapper reports 4 rather than media-success value 3.

evidence.note: Download backend call in the media dispatcher.
Argument 2, call, and restoration of the status value held in r4.

symbols.name: write_early_hw_defaults
symbols.summary: Writes 1 to 0x00800820 and 0x104 to 0x008016c0; exact peripheral purpose is unresolved.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 2.

symbols.name: select_boot_path_code
symbols.summary: Maps cookie selectors to codes 13/0x100/0x101, otherwise derives a code from bits 2-7 at 0x00706034. Publishes C+4.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 12, immediately before media dispatch.

symbols.name: read_clock_profile_code
symbols.summary: Returns code 0x41 when bits 14-15 at 0x00706020 equal one, otherwise 0x14. These are not established MHz values.

evidence.note: Read, mask, shift, compare, and select the two codes.

symbols.name: configure_clock_profile
symbols.summary: Selects a hardware-derived profile code and calls the configuration helper; the selected code is stored in C+0.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 4.

symbols.name: read_rom_dispatch_selector
symbols.summary: Tests bit 0x100 at 0x0020002c, then bit 0x80 on another read if needed, for the alternate ROM-dispatch path.

evidence.note: MMIO base, first test and conditional second read/test.

symbols.name: load_selected_image
symbols.summary: Reads/validates the 0x50-byte header, selects/checks a destination, reads the payload, stores auth inputs and saves loaded/entry fields. Authentication is a later stage.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 18.
Header-read wrapper.
Payload-read wrapper.
Loaded=1; saved entry is the resolved destination.

symbols.name: loader_source_filename_1
symbols.summary: pbl_loader.c error-report filename; not a function entry.

evidence.note: Literal filename bytes.

symbols.name: publish_image_header
symbols.summary: Stores retained header pointer 0x202d8 into S+0x54.

evidence.note: Load header literal, load C.shared, store S+0x54.
Header address 0x202d8.

symbols.name: loader_source_filename_2
symbols.summary: Second pbl_loader.c error-report filename; not a function entry.

evidence.note: Literal filename bytes.

symbols.name: initialize_pmic_path
symbols.summary: Hardware-gated, PMIC-associated initialization can query/poll and sets raw/status words C+0x20/+0x24; detailed meanings remain unresolved.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 8.

symbols.name: rom_start_dispatch
symbols.summary: Selector chooses a branch through SRAM 0x43fe0 after a preparatory call, or installs default exception targets and enters boot_main.

evidence.note: Reads the selector and branches according to its result.
Install default targets, restore frame, tail-branch to 0x6720.

symbols.name: publish_pmic_related_fields
symbols.summary: Copies C+0x20/+0x24 into S+0x58/+0x5c. The default second value is 8, not necessarily zero.

evidence.note: Two context-to-shared-record stores.

symbols.name: build_shared_handoff
symbols.summary: Builds the base shared record, exports media/auth/header fields and tail-publishes PMIC-related fields.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 22, the last non-null normal stage.
Calls base-record initializer 0xbaac.

symbols.name: initialize_runtime_memory
symbols.summary: Copies ROM templates and zeroes several working-memory regions, including the context/shared/header area; distinct from the earlier exception-table installation.

evidence.note: Boot-main prelude calls this before the callback table.
Zero fill of 0x201e8 for 0x170 bytes covers the whole shared record.

symbols.name: initialize_shared_record
symbols.summary: Sets C.shared=0x20240 and initializes identity/constants, service-table pointer and workspace/profile fields in that record.

evidence.note: Stores r4, loaded as 0x20240, at C+0x28.

symbols.name: initialize_boot_context
symbols.summary: Clears the 0x30-byte context; initializes profile and PMIC defaults, default load base 0x2a000000 and last-word address 0x2a03fffc.

evidence.note: First callback.
Reads load-base/size constants and stores base and base+size-4.

symbols.name: register_load_ranges_once
symbols.summary: Once-only range registration for inclusive intervals 0x2e000..0x43e4f and 0x2a000000..0x2a03ffff; not a memory-clear routine.

evidence.note: Callback in word slot 16.

symbols.name: install_default_exception_targets
symbols.summary: Copies 0x20 bytes from ROM 0x124c0 to SRAM 0x43fe0 using the descriptor at 0x11f3c; tail-calls copy_aligned_words.

evidence.note: Loads and dereferences the source, destination and length descriptor addresses.
Tail branch to 0x268, retaining the caller's return address.
Source 0x124c0, destination 0x43fe0, length 0x20.

symbols.name: verify_signed_image
symbols.summary: Authentication-stage callee given header/code ranges, signature and certificate context; full cryptographic implementation is deferred.

evidence.note: Direct call from authenticate_loaded_image.

symbols.name: process_certificate_chain
symbols.summary: Authentication-stage callee consumes certificate-chain and root-policy inputs and returns certificate/metadata context; full contract is deferred.

evidence.note: Direct call before signed-image verification.

symbols.name: boot_stage_slots
symbols.summary: 24 word slots, 12 non-null callbacks. Odd slots are skipped, not terminators. Recovery replays slots 14 through 23.

evidence.note: Complete 0x60-byte dispatch table.

symbols.name: exported_rom_services
symbols.summary: Five function pointers published at S+4: error-hook registration wrapper, two crypto-related helpers, download entry and recovery.

evidence.note: Pointer values; signatures are not all recovered.

symbols.name: exception_target_copy_descriptor
symbols.summary: Three words: ROM source, SRAM destination and byte count for the default exception-pointer table.

evidence.note: Consumed by install_default_exception_targets, not executable code.

symbols.name: rom_identification_banner
symbols.summary: Qualcomm copyright notice followed by boot-ROM and QHSUSB version fields.

evidence.note: ASCII QUALCOMM; the original notice is preserved in NOTICE.md.

symbols.name: zero_suffix
symbols.summary: All captured bytes from this offset to 0x20000 are zero. This is a byte-layout observation, not proof of the physical ROM size.

evidence.note: The last nonzero instruction-sized word is BX lr; the zero suffix begins immediately after it.
